API.prepare: python -m tools.qwen_world_safety_exploration.probe_support prepare --ledger AUDIT/groups.jsonl --population OLDPOPULATION --config E/configs/SAFETY_G16.yaml --il-checkpoint R/IL_PARENT --parent-selection R/PARENT_SELECTION.json --rl-checkpoint ORIGINAL_SAFETY10K --manifest R/data/manifests/FULL_103288.json --data R/data/NAVTRAIN --output /mnt/project/qwen-world-safety-exploration-20261031/data/probes/FROZEN_SAFETY10K_SUPPORT_20261031

execution.style: eight independent one-GPU processes; no DDP/process-group initialization; cuda:0 mapped by CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
execution.torchrun: NOT supported as an implicit8rank launcher: run explicit --rank N per one-GPU job; CLI rank is not read from env
execution.partition: cases[rank::8]; 39 scenes and2496 generated/scored candidates each
execution.lease_stop: new task authorization and boundary_stop_due before each scene; no other owner/resource controls touched
execution.resume: same manifest/source/identity/output; completed scene+NPZ adopted, rank lock prevents concurrent identical shard
execution.model: GroupRuntime G16 loads originalIL70; restore only all52.7M current trainable adapters/memory from Safety10k optimizer.pt; originalILref unchanged; no optimizer/grads/checkpoint
execution.receipts: rankN.json COMPLETE + exact expected/completed token lists; scene JSON and NPZ immutable hash; only all8 complete produce SUMMARY.json; infrastructure failures never zero/partial mean

science.rng: seed42 private per TRAIN token; full16 root draw and ordered3 innovations reset before ABC, D uses same roots only. B same innovation order at different diffusion times; actual std(t) explicitly reported; C reuses first root but consumes all16 original root draw.
science.B1: D_ODE first candidate reused, seed42 training-private root; not old seed2101 canonical evaluation
science.nested8: nested subset of the G16 draw; not an independently executed G8 batch/RNG stream
science.readouts: found-quality/feasible/unsafe/best-safe; paired support gains/losses; rawSafetyA PG support; current diagnosticB1; camera/prefill/generated/scored/actor-forward costs
limits: TRAIN selected historical pool and controls are diagnostic; no NAV score/generalization result
Same eta and3steps at different times changes actual noise energy; not identical action perturbation
Nested first8 is not standalone old G8 forward/RNG stream
Historical witness/control labels are never reused as new generated-trajectory labels
No unextracted geometric margins/risk probability; no teacher or new actor observation
